reason: Adaptyv Bio is a ~30-person Swiss ($10.9M seed, Lausanne/Epalinges) B2B cloud-lab whose entire product surface is a web portal, a REST 'Foundry API' and a Benchling integration — there is no companion mobile app, no BLE consumer/medical device, and no app-store dependency, so David's niche (connected hardware whose companion iOS/Android app is the bottleneck) does not apply; its fresh 32-role job feed contains zero mobile/iOS/Android/app-store postings, and the only leadership signal, 'Head of Software Engineering', is scoped to lab-automation orchestration, backend and AI systems, making it a generic engineering-hiring match rather than evidence of the pain he fixes.
